title: Grilled German Sausage Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot dish made with juicy German sausages and snappy vegetables.

ingredients.name: German sausages
ingredients.notes: you can use any type of German sausage you like (e.g. Weisswurst or Bratwurst)

instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, beer (if using), salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the sausages to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
